answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the fable queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1855 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the jade. The island index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 382 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
